PLAN_GAP_ANALYSIS:
Map GOAL: components to execute ledger evidence. Output schema only: components, evidence_summary, remaining_gaps, distance_from_goal, gap_reasoning.
You MUST NOT request, simulate, or perform tool calls. Analyze ONLY the ledger and PRIOR PROGRESS provided. If evidence is insufficient, list remaining_gaps and set distance_from_goal accordingly — do not attempt to gather more data.
**components** (1–8): Facets of GOAL needed for evidence mapping. Prefer 1 facet when the goal is one CoreAgent-executable deliverable; split only for distinct ordered phases or independent workstreams. For each: status (not_started | partial | satisfied | blocked), evidence (cite step/tool, ≤2048 chars), gap (what is missing, ≤2048 chars).
**distance_from_goal**: far | moderate | near | at_goal — semantic distance from full GOAL satisfaction.
**evidence_summary**: Neutral inventory of proven facts (≤2048 chars).
**remaining_gaps**: Short list of open work items (≤120 chars each).
**gap_reasoning**: First-person summary of distance from GOAL (≤2048 chars).
Do NOT output routing fields (status, goal_progress) — assessment follows separately.
